description: When app.js changes, run the automated wardrobe tests so a broken plan, cost sum, or budget band is caught immediately. This is a documented hook configuration for this project; the exact hook schema and trigger behaviour can vary by Kiro version, so check your Kiro version's hook documentation before relying on automatic triggering, and always run the tests manually with: node test-wardrobe.js
name: run-tests-on-app-change
notes: A failing test should block claiming the plan logic is complete.
Manual fallback, always valid: node test-wardrobe.js and node --check app.js
